summary: Verified Verifone conditions PDF attachment fix. All 3 backend tests passed: (1) CREATE Verifone quote as PYME user attaches condiciones_verifone_tbp.pdf (2 pages total in both response bytes and disk file). (2) MODIFY/regenerate existing PYME Verifone quote (quo_34d3d4705085 / COT-2026-04-076-PYME) now includes TBP conditions (2 pages) — bug fix confirmed. (3) Regression: MODIFY of a non-PYME (CORP/LCH) Verifone quote attaches condiciones_verifone.pdf (3 pages total: 1 base + 2 LCH conditions). The fix applied in routes/quotes.py::regenerate_equipment_pdf (call to append_equipment_conditions after weasyprint.HTML.write_pdf) works correctly for both sedes.

Consider migrating from deprecated PyPDF2 to pypdf (deprecation warning emitted).
routes/quotes.py is very large (>3000 lines); could be split into smaller modules for maintainability.

rca of the issue: Bug: routes/quotes.py::regenerate_equipment_pdf regenerated PDF via weasyprint but did NOT call append_equipment_conditions(), so on Modify the Verifone TBP/LCH conditions page was stripped. Fix: after pdf_bytes = weasyprint.HTML(...).write_pdf(), call append_equipment_conditions(pdf_bytes, equipment_type, quote.get('sede') or current_user.get('sede','PYME')). Verified: regenerated PDF for PYME Verifone quo_34d3d4705085 now has 2 pages (1 base + 1 TBP).
